findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_llm_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Official API list prices (USD per 1M tokens) with Artificial Analysis, LiveBench and Epoch AI scores for major US and Chinese LLMs. Filter and sort." → after: "Official API list prices (USD per 1M tokens) with Artificial Analysis, LiveBench 2.0 and Epoch AI scores for major US and Chinese LLMs. Filter and sort."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
